description.zh: 研究报告需要连接来源，视觉评审需要对应界面状态，批量分类还要抽查例外。Gemini 的任务输入应随证据类型准备，再按实际可用路径分别检查结论和输出。
description.en: Cross-document research, screenshot reviews, and text classification organize evidence in different ways. Compare the sources, visual states, and sample checks each task requires before choosing an available Gemini route and preparing its input.

Research across several documents requires a question and clear citation rules. Connect themes and compare claims while retaining disagreements and statements that remain unverified. A source-mapped synthesis should show which files support each conclusion and where evidence is still missing, rather than flattening the collection into one apparent consensus.
description.zh: 跨文档研究需要明确的问题和引用要求。连接不同文件中的主题与论点时，保留来源之间的分歧和未核实说法。综合报告应能说明每项结论由哪些文件支持、哪些位置仍缺乏证据，而不是把多份资料压成看似一致的结论。

description.en: A visual product review can combine requirements, written feedback, and screenshots of the same flow. Map visible states to the expected behavior and prioritize findings by user impact. Ground each issue in the supplied screen evidence and requirements so a visual observation is not mistaken for an untested functional claim.
description.zh: 评审产品界面时，将同一流程的需求、文字反馈和截图放在一起，逐一对应可见状态与预期行为，再按用户影响排列问题。每条发现都应关联到具体截图和要求，避免把视觉观察直接写成尚未验证的功能结论。

description.en: Batch classification needs explicit categories, boundary rules, and labeled examples. Process the texts against those criteria, spot-check a sample, and retain ambiguous cases for review. Return classification results with exceptions and sample checks so volume does not hide where the rules need clarification.
description.zh: 批量分类前，明确分类规则、类别边界和带标签的参考样本。按统一标准处理文本后抽查结果，将有歧义的记录单独保留。分类结果应同时包含例外情况和样本核验记录，让处理量增加时仍能看清规则需要补充的位置。

title.en: Long context, mixed inputs, and a faster companion model.
title.zh: 超长上下文、混合输入，以及一个更快的搭档。

description.en: Large source sets, image-and-text analysis, and frequent responses impose different constraints on a workflow. Review the recorded Gemini capabilities alongside the separate image-generation lane so input understanding and producing a new image are not treated as the same operation.
description.zh: 理解已有图文和生成新图像使用不同路径。Gemini 的大资料分析与高频响应也有各自约束，工作流需要根据已记录能力准备输入，再单独确认对应的图像生成入口。

description.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is positioned for long documents, large code sets, and cross-file work.
description.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 面向长文档、大型代码集与跨文件工作。

description.en: Pro can analyze visual and textual material together in the client workflow.
description.zh: Pro 可在客户端工作流中结合分析图像与文本材料。

description.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash handles frequent lightweight requests with a faster cadence.
description.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 以更快节奏处理高频轻量请求。

description.en: Gemini image models are live through `ai-image-drawing`, not the main chat picker.
description.zh: Gemini 图像模型通过 `ai-image-drawing` 上线，不属于主对话选择器。

title.en: Choose by what is slowing the work down.
title.zh: 根据真正拖慢工作的因素进行选择。

items.en: You need to inspect a large source set as a whole.
items.zh: 需要把大型资料集作为一个整体分析。

items.en: The task combines images, text, or many files.
items.zh: 任务同时包含图像、文本或大量文件。

items.en: Relationships across the material matter more than response speed.
items.zh: 材料之间的关系比响应速度更重要。

title.en: Choose Flash or another route when
title.zh: 这些情况改选 Flash 或其他路径

items.en: The task is repeated, lightweight, and latency-sensitive.
items.zh: 任务重复、轻量且对延迟敏感。

items.en: Deep architecture decisions are the main risk; consider Claude Opus.
items.zh: 主要风险是深层架构决策，可考虑 Claude Opus。

items.en: The deliverable is a generated image; use the drawing Combo.
items.zh: 交付物是生成图片，应使用画图 Combo。

question.en: Is Gemini 3.1 Pro still a preview model?
question.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 仍是预览版吗？

answer.en: The recorded Floatboat ID is `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`. This is an integration identifier from the earlier snapshot, not a claim about every current Google release; check the actual client entry.
answer.zh: Floatboat 较早接入记录中的 ID 为 `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`。它不能用于判断 Google 当前所有版本的发布状态，使用时应核对客户端实际入口。

question.en: Should I always use Pro for better quality?
question.zh: 为了质量是否总该使用 Pro？

answer.en: No. Flash is the better fit when latency and throughput define success; Pro is for context-heavy or multimodal analysis.
answer.zh: 不需要。若成功标准是延迟与吞吐，Flash 更合适；Pro 适合上下文密集或多模态分析。

question.en: What does the 1M+ context help with?
question.zh: 1M+ 上下文适合解决什么问题？

answer.en: It is useful when relationships across a large document set, many files, or mixed text-and-image material need to remain visible in one analysis.
answer.zh: 当一次分析需要保留大型文档集、大量文件或图文混合材料之间的关系时，1M+ 上下文更有价值。

question.en: Which Gemini image-generation models are listed?
question.zh: 有哪些 Gemini 图像生成模型？

answer.en: The matrix lists `gemini-3-pro-image-preview`, `gemini-2.5-flash-image`, and `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` for complex generation, editing, and faster image work.
answer.zh: 矩阵列出 `gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image` 与 `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`，分别覆盖复杂生成、编辑与快速生图。

question.en: What is the Gemini 3.1 Pro model ID?
question.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 Model ID 是什么？

answer.en: The earlier Floatboat record uses `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, with `3.1-pro` as a display alias. Preserve the exact ID shown by the current integration rather than assuming provider naming has not changed.
answer.zh: 较早的 Floatboat 记录使用 `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`，展示别名为 `3.1-pro`。应保留当前接入实际提供的准确 ID，不要假定供应商命名始终不变。

question.en: How can I tell whether a large-context Gemini run used the right evidence?
question.zh: 怎样判断 Gemini 的长上下文任务是否用对了证据？

answer.en: Plant a few verifiable questions across the source set and ask for references to the relevant files or passages. Check contradictory and low-salience details as well as the summary; fitting material into a window does not show that every part influenced the answer.
answer.zh: 从材料不同位置选择几个可核验的问题，要求标明文件或段落。除摘要外，也检查矛盾和不显眼的细节；资料能放进窗口，不代表每一部分都真正影响了回答。

question.en: Is Gemini 4 Argon the same entry as Gemini 3.1 Pro?
question.zh: Gemini 4 Argon 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 是同一个入口吗？

answer.en: No equivalence has been confirmed. Floatboat’s pricing page names Gemini 4 Argon separately; retain the distinction and use the model name and entry actually exposed in the client.
answer.zh: 目前没有确认它们等价。Floatboat 价格页单独列出了 Gemini 4 Argon，应保留版本区别，并使用客户端实际提供的名称和入口。

title.en: Read across files with Pro, move quickly with Flash
title.zh: 跨文件分析选 Pro，快速处理选 Flash

description.en: Choose Gemini 3.1 Pro for multimodal, long-context analysis and 3.8 Flash for fast passes over the same material.
description.zh: 用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 分析长上下文与多模态资料，用 3.8 Flash 快速处理同一项目中的日常任务。
